question: Should interactive `litellm-api-key` onboarding grow its own proxy base-URL prompt before model selection, or should remote LiteLLM users be routed to Custom Provider/shared catalog setup instead?
rationale: Both approaches can solve the user problem, but the choice changes provider-owned onboarding UX, credentialed endpoint probing policy, and the boundary between a bundled LiteLLM provider and generic OpenAI-compatible proxy setup.

options.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
options.body: Have the LiteLLM provider-owned interactive setup ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while keeping the current non-interactive flag behavior.

options.title: Route Remote Users To Custom Provider
options.body: Keep `litellm-api-key` as localhost/default-model setup and update prompts/docs so remote LiteLLM proxy users choose Custom Provider for URL and model setup.

options.title: Defer To Shared Live Catalog
options.body: Leave the issue open until maintainers settle the broader credentialed provider catalog and model discovery policy.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
recommendation.body: Have the LiteLLM provider-owned interactive setup ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while keeping the current non-interactive flag behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent LiteLLM provider setup boundary in history and already made the related non-interactive scope decision.
